// arg : { name = 'Target Color'  var = 'm_target'  range = '0 255'  value = '1'  step = '1'  precision = '0' }
// arg : { name = 'New Color'  var = 'm_new'  range = '0 255'  value = '7'  step = '1'  precision = '0' }
// xs_end

// Recolours the voxels of the current colour, like the many xs shaders
// that work on one colour of the model.
float map(vec3 v) {
  float index = voxel(v);
  return index == i_color_index ? m_new : index;
}
